item.title: North Korea Deletes 'Reunification' from Constitution, Adds 'Territorial Clause'…'Hostile Nation' Omitted (북, 헌법에 ‘통일’ 지우고 ‘영토 조항’ 신설…‘적대적 국가’는 빠져)
item.description:
North Korea has been confirmed to have newly inserted a territorial clause in its recently revised constitution and deleted the clause on the reunification of the fatherland. It was found that the expression 'hostile two-state' advocated by North Korean State Affairs Commission Chairman Kim Jong-un was not included in the constitution. Professor Lee Jeong-cheol of Seoul National University presented this analysis during a press briefing for the Unification Ministry's press corps held at the Seoul Government Complex on the 6th. (북한이 최근 개정한 헌법에 영토 조항을 신설하고, 조국통일 조항을 삭제한 것으로 확인됐다. 김정은 북한 국무위원장이 주장해 온 ‘적대적 두 국가’ 관련 표현은 헌법에 담지 않은 것으로 나타났다. 6일 정부서울청사에서 열린 통일부 기자단 대상 언론간담회에서 이정철 서울대학교 교수는 이렇게 분석했다.)

The newly established territorial clause in Article 2 of the North Korean constitution states: 'The territory of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea includes the land bordering the People's Republic of China to the north, the Russian Federation to the north, and the Republic of Korea to the south, along with the territorial sea and airspace established on that basis. The Democratic People's Republic of Korea absolutely does not allow any infringement of its territory.' North Korea revised the constitution with this content at the first session of the 15th Supreme People's Assembly in March. In the preamble and main text, terms such as 'northern half,' 'reunification of the fatherland,' and 'complete victory of socialism'—indicative of ethnic kinship and reunification concepts—have all been removed. (북한 헌법 2조에 신설된 영토 조항은 ‘조선민주주의인민공화국 영역은 북쪽으로 중화인민공화국과 러시아 연방, 남쪽으로 대한민국과 접하고 있는 영토와 그에 기초하여 설정된 영해와 영공을 포함한다. 조선민주주의인민공화국은 영역에 대한 그 어떤 침해도 절대로 허용하지 않는다’고 명시됐다. 북한은 지난 3월 연 최고인민회의 제15기 제1차 회의에서 이런 내용으로 헌법을 개정했다. 서문·본문에선 ‘북반부’, ‘조국통일’, ‘사회주의의 완전한 승리’ 등 동족 관계와 통일 개념도 모두 사라졌다.)

Regarding the 'hostile two-state theory' that North Korea has mentioned, Professor Lee said, 'In this constitution, the descriptive term "hostile" could not be found,' adding, 'While a territorial clause was added to emphasize statehood, expressions like hostile relations or belligerent relations do not appear.' (이정철 교수는 북한이 언급해 온 적대적 두 국가론과 관련 “이번 헌법에선 ‘적대적’이란 형용사 표현은 찾아볼 수 없었다”며 “영토 조항을 신설해 국가성을 강조했지만 적대적 관계, 교전국 관계 등의 표현은 등장하지 않는다”고 말했다.)

The revised constitution explicitly stipulates the authority of the chairman of the State Affairs Commission to use nuclear weapons for the first time. In Article 89 of the constitution, North Korea created a new provision stating, 'The command authority over the nuclear force of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea lies with the chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea,' and that 'the chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea can delegate the authority to use nuclear force to the national nuclear force command body.' (개정 헌법엔 국무위원장의 핵사용 권한이 최초로 명시됐다. 북한은 헌법 89조에 “조선민주주의인민공화국 핵무력에 대한 지휘권은 조선민주주의인민공화국 국무위원회 위원장에게 있다”며 “조선민주주의인민공화국 국무위원회 위원장은 국가핵무력지휘기구에 핵무력사용권한을 위임할 수 있다”는 내용을 새로 만들었다.)

North Korea also changed the name of the constitution from the 'Socialist Constitution' revised in September 2023 to simply 'Constitution,' removing the word 'socialist.' Additionally, all references to the achievements of former leaders Kim Il-sung and Kim Jong-il, listed in the preamble, were deleted. (북한은 헌법의 이름도 2023년 9월 개정한 ‘사회주의 헌법’에서 ‘사회주의’를 빼고 ‘헌법’으로 고쳤다. 또 서문에 기재된 김일성·김정일 전 위원장 등 선대의 업적을 모두 삭제했다.)

Jang Ye-ji Reporter penj@hani.co.kr (장예지 기자 penj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: [Breaking News] Chung Eui-yong: “Suspected Attack on Korean Ship Unclear… Review of ‘Liberation Project’ No Longer Needed” ([속보] 위성락 “한국 선박 피격 불확실…‘해방 프로젝트’ 검토 불필요해져”)
item.description:
National Security Office Director Chung Eui-yong stated on the 6th regarding the fire on a Korean ship in the Strait of Hormuz, “Initially, the possibility of an attack was raised, but after additional review of information, the attack does not appear certain.” He also noted that as President Donald Trump has withdrawn the proposal for the ‘Liberation Project’ (Project Freedom), there is no longer a need to review participation. (위성락 국가안보실장이 6일 호르무즈 해상의 우리 선박 화재와 관련해 “초기에 피격 가능성이 거론됐는데, 정보를 추가 검토해보니 피격이 확실하지 않은 것 같다”고 말했다. 또 도널드 트럼프 대통령이 ‘해방 프로젝트’(프로젝트 프리덤) 제안을 거둬들임에 따라 더 이상 참여 검토가 필요하지 않게 됐다고 밝혔다.)

Director Chung said in a briefing at the Blue House, “The ship (the HMM Naveen) that caught fire is currently being towed and is expected to arrive at the port around dawn tomorrow. The investigation team will then go and assess the situation. There has been no flooding or tilting so far.” (위 실장은 이날 청와대에서 한 브리핑에서 “(화재가 발생한 에이치엠엠 나무) 선박은 예인 중에 있는데, 내일 새벽쯤 항구로 들어올 것 같다. 그러면 조사팀이 가서 파악할 예정”이라며 “일단 침수라든지 기울임은 없었다”고 말했다.)

Director Chung also stated that they have decided not to continue discussions on the ‘Liberation Project’ proposed by the United States. (위 실장은 미국이 제안한 ‘해방 프로젝트’와 관련해 더 이상 논의를 이어가지 않기로 했다고 말했다.)

Director Chung elaborated, “The US had previously proposed a maritime freedom initiative, and we were reviewing it. Last Monday, President Trump introduced the concept of the ‘Liberation Project’ (as a new proposal). He mentioned that, upon learning of the fire on our ship, it seemed we would join the US mission. The US appears to be speaking under the premise that our ship was attacked, but we are in a situation where we want to confirm further.” Earlier, on the 28th, the US State Department proposed participation in the ‘Maritime Freedom Coalition’ (MFO), a multinational coalition to open passage through the Strait of Hormuz. Then, on the 3rd, it proposed the ‘Liberation Project’ as a ship rescue operation within the strait. (위 실장은 “미국이 해양자유구상이라는 것을 내놓은 적이 있어서 우리가 그것을 검토하고 있는데, 지난 월요일에 트럼프 대통령이 ‘해방 프로젝트’라는 개념을 (새롭게) 내놓았다. 우리 선박 화재 상황이 발생한 것을 인지하고 우리가 미국 임무에 참여할 것 같다는 언급을 했다”며 “미국은 우리 배가 피격당했다는 전제 하에 얘기하는 것 같지만, 우리는 좀 더 확인하려는 상황”이라고 말했다. 앞서 미국 국무부는 지난 28일 호르무즈해협 통항로를 열기 위한 다국적 연합체인 ‘해양자유연합’(MFO) 참여를 제안했다. 그러다 지난 3일에는 호르무즈해협 내 선박 구출 작전인 ‘해방 프로젝트’를 또다시 제안했다.)

Director Chung stated, “We are in the process of understanding how the US’s maritime freedom initiative and the Liberation Project relate to each other. The maritime freedom initiative seems to be a broad approach for stabilizing the strait and ensuring freedom of navigation, while the Liberation Project appears to be an immediate support operation for transiting the strait.” He added, “We were intending to review the Liberation Project as well, but since President Trump has suspended the operation, I believe a review is no longer necessary.” (위 실장은 “미국이 얘기하는 해양자유구상과 해방 프로젝트 (관계가) 어떻게 되는지 우리가 파악하는 과정에 있다”며 “아마도 해양자유구상은 해협 안정화와 통항의 자유를 위한 폭넓은 접근인 것 같고, 해방 프로젝트는 당장 해협 통과를 위한 조력 작전인 거 같아 보인다”고 말했다. 그러면서 위 실장은 “해방 프로젝트에 대해서도 검토를 하려고 했는데, (트럼프 대통령이) 작전을 중단했기 때문에 (더 이상) 검토는 필요하지 않게 됐다고 생각한다”고 덧붙였다.)

Reporter Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr (서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Floor Leader Han Byung-do Re-elected... "Timing, Procedure, Content of Special Counsel Bill to Be After Local Elections" (한병도 원내대표 연임…“특검법 시기·절차·내용, 지방선거 뒤로”)
item.description:
On the 6th, Floor Leader Han Byung-do, who succeeded in being re-elected as the floor leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, stated regarding the "Fabricated Indictment Special Counsel Bill," "Concerning the timing, procedure, and content of handling the special counsel bill, we will gather opinions from the public and party members after the June 3 local elections and make a judgment after sufficient deliberation." (6일 더불어민주당 원내대표 연임에 성공한 한병도 원내대표가 ‘조작기소 특검법안’에 대해 “특검법 처리 시기와 절차, 내용과 관련해서는 6·3지방선거 이후 국민과 당원 의견을 수렴하고 숙의 절차를 충분히 거쳐 판단하겠다”고 밝혔다.)

Floor Leader Han said this after being elected as the new floor leader at the party's general meeting that day, adding, "Through the parliamentary investigation last April, the unjust investigations and illegal acts of the political prosecution were revealed to the world, and a public consensus has been formed on the need for a special counsel." He added, "Uncovering the truth and restoring judicial justice through a special counsel is a task the Democratic Party must undertake." ( 한 원내대표는 이날 의원총회에서 새 원내대표로 선출된 뒤 “지난 4월 국정조사를 거쳐 정치검찰의 부당한 수사와 불법 행위가 만천하에 밝혀졌고, 특검 필요성에 대해 국민적 공감대가 형성됐다”며 이렇게 말했다. 그는 “특검을 통한 진실규명과 사법정의 회복은 민주당이 반드시 해야 할 일”이라고 덧붙였다. )

In his acceptance speech, Floor Leader Han said, "The next year is the golden time for the success of the Lee Jae-myung administration," and pledged, "We will secure momentum for state affairs through a landslide victory in the local elections and complete all legislative tasks for national agenda by the end of the year to firmly support the president." His immediate tasks include organizing the second half of the National Assembly, the "Fabricated Indictment Special Counsel Bill," and revising the Criminal Procedure Act, including whether to grant supplementary investigation powers to the prosecution. ( 한 원내대표는 당선 수락연설에서 “앞으로 1년이 이재명 정부 성공의 골든타임”이라며 지방선거 압승으로 국정운영의 동력을 확보하고, 연말까지 국정과제 입법을 모두 마무리해 대통령을 든든히 지원하겠다”고 말했다. 한 원내대표의 당면 과제는 후반기 원구성과 ‘조작기소 특검법안’, 검찰 보완수사권 부여 여부를 포함한 형사소송법 개정 등이다. )

Floor Leader Han, a three-term senior lawmaker from the Honam region, was elected in a by-election held in January following the resignation of former Floor Leader Kim Byung-gi, and has handled major issues such as prosecution and judicial reform bills, the Special Act on Investment in the U.S., and the war supplementary budget. He ran unopposed in this floor leader election, and his term is one year. ( 한 원내대표는 호남 출신의 3선 중진으로 지난 1월 김병기 전 원내대표 사퇴로 치러진 보궐선거에서 당선돼 검찰·사법 개혁안, 대미투자특별법, 전쟁 추가경정예산안 등의 주요 현안을 처리했다. 이번 원내대표 선거에서는 단독 출마했으며, 임기는 1년이다. )

Reporter Lee Ji-eun jieuny@hani.co.kr ( 이지은 기자 jieuny@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Prime Minister Takaichi Eyes Late May Visit to South Korea…Four Months After President Lee's Japan Trip (다카이치 총리 5월 하순 방한 추진…이 대통령 방일 넉달 만)
item.description:
Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi is reportedly planning to visit South Korea later this month for a South Korea-Japan summit. This move appears aimed at continuing the shuttle diplomacy pledged by the two countries' leaders. (다카이치 사나에 일본 총리가 이달 하순께 방한해 한-일 정상회담을 하는 방안이 추진되고 있다. 양국 정상이 공언한 셔틀외교를 이어가기 위한 차원으로 보인다.)

According to diplomatic sources on the 6th, Prime Minister Takaichi is considering a two-day visit to South Korea later this month. If realized, this would mark the first face-to-face meeting between the two leaders in over four months since President Jae-myung Lee visited Takaichi's hometown of Nara Prefecture, Japan, in January for a summit. (6일 외교가에 따르면, 다카이치 총리는 이달 하순께 1박2일 일정으로 방한하는 계획을 검토 중인 것으로 알려졌다. 이번 방한이 성사되면 지난 1월 이재명 대통령이 다카이치 총리의 고향인 일본 나라현을 찾아 한-일 정상회담을 한 지 4개월여 만에 양국 정상이 마주 앉게 된다.)

President Lee and Prime Minister Takaichi previously held a summit at the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) meeting in Gyeongju last October, where they agreed to continue the shuttle diplomacy between South Korea and Japan, which was restored under former Prime Minister Shigeru Ishiba. Prime Minister Takaichi had earlier considered visiting South Korea in March during her trip to the United States for a summit with President Donald Trump, but it was not realized due to scheduling conflicts. (이 대통령과 다카이치 총리는 지난해 10월 경주 아시아태평양경제협력체(APEC) 정상회의에서 정상회담을 하고 이시바 시게루 전 총리 시절 복원된 한·일 정상 간 셔틀외교를 이어가기로 합의한 바 있다. 다카이치 총리는 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령과 정상회담을 위해 미국을 찾았던 지난 3월 방한을 검토했으나 일정상의 이유로 성사되지 못했다.)

Reporter Woo-sam Shim wu32@hani.co.kr (심우삼 기자 wu32@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Ambassador Kang Kyung-wha Sends Reply to US Republican Lawmakers 'Defending Coupang' (강경화 주미대사, ‘쿠팡 옹호’ 미 공화당 의원들에 답신 발송)
item.description:
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs announced on the 6th that Ambassador to the US Kang Kyung-wha has sent a reply regarding a joint letter from US Republican lawmakers alleging that the South Korean government is discriminating against US companies, including Coupang. (외교부는 한국 정부가 쿠팡 등 미국 기업을 차별하고 있다고 주장하는 미국 공화당 의원들의 연명 서한에 대해 강경화 주미대사 명의 답신을 발송했다고 6일 밝혔다.)

A Ministry of Foreign Affairs official stated that day, "In the reply, our government once again explained that our government's measures, including the investigation related to Coupang, are being conducted in a non-discriminatory and fair manner in accordance with relevant domestic laws and regulations," adding, "We will continue to maintain a non-discriminatory policy toward US digital companies, including Coupang, and will keep explaining the relevant details to the US Congress." (외교부 관계자는 이날 “우리 정부는 답신을 통해 쿠팡 관련 조사 등 우리 정부 조치가 관련 국내법 및 규정에 따라 비차별적이고 공정하게 진행 중임을 다시 한번 설명했다”며 “앞으로도 쿠팡을 포함한 미국 디지털 기업에 대한 비차별 정책을 견지하면서, 관련 내용을 미 의회에 지속 설명해나갈 예정”이라고 말했다.)

Previously, on the 21st of last month (local time), 54 lawmakers from the Republican Study Committee (RSC), a group of US House Republicans, sent a letter to Ambassador Kang requesting an immediate halt to discriminatory regulations against US companies operating in South Korea. They particularly defended Coupang over its data breach incident caused by management negligence, claiming that "a low-sensitivity data breach incident was used as a pretext to launch a government-wide attack on Coupang." They also stated that Coupang had been "the largest source of US foreign direct investment (FDI) in South Korea over the past decade." (앞서 미국 연방 하원 공화당 의원 모임인 ‘공화당 연구위원회’(RSC) 소속 의원 54명은 지난달 21일(현지시각) 한국에서 사업하는 미국 기업들에 대한 차별적인 규제를 즉각 중단해달라는 내용의 서한을 강 대사에게 보냈다. 이들은 특히 쿠팡의 관리 잘못으로 인한 정보 유출 사건에 대해 “민감도가 낮은(low-sensitivity) 정보 유출 사건을 구실로 쿠팡에 범정부적 공격을 가했다”면서 쿠팡을 일방적으로 옹호했다. 이들은 쿠팡이 “지난 10년간 미국의 한국 대상 외국인직접투자(FDI)의 최대 원천”이었다고 했다.)

Amid Coupang's extensive lobbying efforts targeting the US Congress and government, it has been understood that the US government and Congress recently conveyed a message to the South Korean government, indicating that unless the personal safety issues of Coupang Inc. Chairman Kim Beom-seok are resolved, progress in high-level consultations on security areas—such as South Korea's construction of nuclear-powered submarines and uranium enrichment and reprocessing, as outlined in last year's Joint Fact Sheet between the South Korean and US leaders—would be difficult. (쿠팡이 미국 의회와 정부에 광범위한 로비를 벌이고 있는 가운데, 최근 미국 정부와 의회 등은 김범석 쿠팡아이엔씨 의장의 신변 안전 문제가 해결되지 않으면 지난해 한·미 정상이 조인트 팩트 시트에 명시한 한국의 핵추진잠수함 건조와 우라늄 농축·재처리 등 안보 분야에 대한 고위급 협의 진전이 어려울 것이라는 메시지를 최근 우리 정부에 전한 것으로 파악됐다.)

Senior Correspondent Park Min-hee minggu@hani.co.kr (박민희 선임기자 minggu@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Former lawmaker Kim Ui-kyum strategically nominated as Democratic Party candidate for by-election in Gunsan, Gimje, Buan Gap, North Jeolla (김의겸 전 의원, 전북 군산·김제·부안갑 재선거 민주당 후보에 전략공천)
item.description:
The Democratic Party of Korea has nominated former lawmaker Kim Ui-kyum as its candidate for the parliamentary by-election in Gunsan, Gimje, and Buan Gap, North Jeolla, which will be held alongside the June 3 local elections. (더불어민주당이 6·3 지방선거와 함께 치러지는 국회의원 재보궐선거 전북 군산·김제·부안갑 후보로 김의겸 전 의원을 공천했다.  )

The party's Strategic Nomination Management Committee announced the results of strategic nominations for five regions, including this one, on the 6th. Senior spokesperson Kang Jun-hyun explained in a briefing, "Candidate Kim, a native of Gunsan, served as the first director of the Saemangeum Development Agency under the Lee Jae-myung administration," adding, "He is the best person to design the future of Saemangeum, Buan, and Gimje." Candidate Kim previously served as a spokesperson for the Moon Jae-in administration's Blue House and as a proportional representative lawmaker for the Open Democratic Party in the 21st National Assembly. Later serving as a spokesperson when President Lee Jae-myung was party leader, he was appointed in July last year as the first director of the Saemangeum Development Agency under the Lee administration. Senior spokesperson Kang said, "Former lawmaker Kim, having served as director of the Saemangeum Development Agency, is the candidate who best understands the Saemangeum industry, the region's biggest issue." <<> Supreme Council member Park Ji-won has been nominated as the candidate for the Gunsan, Gimje, and Buan Eul district in North Jeolla. Spokesperson Kang introduced him as "a son of North Jeolla, a son-in-law of Gimje, who has demonstrated professionalism as a lawyer for regional development in his hometown," and "the first ordinary party member to become a Supreme Council member in Democratic Party history, symbolizing one person, one vote in the era of party member sovereignty." In Gwangju Gwangsan Eul, Lim Mun-young, vice chair of the National Artificial Intelligence Strategy Committee, received the nomination; in Seogwipo, Jeju, former Vice Minister of Oceans and Fisheries Kim Sung-bum was nominated; and in Daegu Dalseong, Park Hyung-ryong, chair of the Dalseong Regional Committee, was nominated. Candidate Park will face off against Lee Jin-sook of the People Power Party. <<> The Democratic Party has left only the nomination for the by-election candidate in Gongju, Buyeo, and Cheongyang in South Chungcheong among the 14 parliamentary by-election districts. Former Buyeo County Mayor Park Jung-hyun applied for nomination there, but was deemed ineligible to run by the National Election Commission due to the late timing of his resignation as county mayor. After announcing the nomination results, Secretary-General Cho Seung-rae met with reporters and said, "Former Kongju University President Won Sung-soo is already running for the Sejong City education superintendent seat, but I met with him yesterday thinking he is suitable for Gongju's development," adding, "I am additionally contacting one person from a young legal professional background." <<> Reporter Jeong Hye-min jhm@hani.co.kr Reporter Kim Chae-woon cwk@hani.co.kr (민주당 전략공천관리위원회는 6일 이 지역을 포함한 5곳의 전략공천 결과를 발표했다. 강준현 수석대변인은 브리핑에서 “군산 토박이인 김 후보는 이재명 정부 초대 새만금개발청장을 역임했다”며 “새만금과 부안·김제의 미래를 설계할 최적임자”라고 설명했다. 김 후보는 문재인 정부 청와대 대변인과 21대 국회에서 열린민주당 비례대표 국회의원을 지냈다. 이후 이재명 대통령이 당 대표일 때 대변인을 맡았던 그는 지난해 7월 이재명 정부 초대 새만금개발청장에 임명됐다. 강 수석대변인은 “김 전 의원이 새만금 개발청장을 역임하며 지역의 최대 현안인새만금 산업을 가장 잘 이해하고 있는 후보”라고 말했다. )

item.title: Han Dong-hoon and Park Min-shik "No Coalition" — Rising Tensions Amid Similar Approval Ratings (한동훈·박민식 “단일화 안 해”…엇비슷한 지지율에 치열해지는 신경전)
item.description:
Tensions are escalating between Park Min-shik, the People Power Party candidate, and Han Dong-hoon, an independent candidate, in the by-election for the National Assembly seat in Buk-gu, Busan. Amid discussions of a possible coalition between the candidates, both are set to hold the opening ceremonies for their election offices on the 10th at the same time, launching into a full-scale contest. <<> On the 6th, regarding the possibility of a coalition, Candidate Park launched an offensive toward Han, saying, "Wake up." He stated, "It’s true that former Minister Han has been lurking around Daegu and Haeundae for everyone to see," and added, "Suddenly, just a month ahead, he’s barged into Buk-gu under the banner of rebuilding conservatism. The residents of Buk-gu are beyond bewildered, thinking, 'Why is this person here?' Many are feeling offended and angered, asking, 'Does he look down on us that much?'" <<> He then directed remarks toward Han’s camp, saying, "I don’t know why they’re so fixated on a coalition," and "Most of those clamoring for a coalition are from former Minister Han’s inner circle. In modern terms, wake up." Candidate Park had said the day before, after being confirmed as the People Power Party candidate, that "the possibility of a coalition is zero." <<> Candidate Han struck back. In an interview with a media outlet that day, regarding the People Power Party’s nomination of Park, he said, "The faction backing Representative Jang Dong-hyuk has maintained the stance of 'It’s fine to lose to the Democratic Party, just block Han Dong-hoon,'" and expressed, "In that sense, it’s regrettable." Han’s camp is also drawing a line on coalition discussions. Rep. Bae Hyun-jin of the pro-Han faction said on Channel A’s YouTube that day, "Based on my conversations with Candidate Han, he’s not particularly interested in a coalition," adding, "Because it’s a time to test his own competitiveness on his own, Han Dong-hoon’s current fight is solely with himself." <<> As the two candidates’ poll results show no significant difference, their determination to see the race through appears to be strengthening. According to a poll commissioned by SBS and conducted by Ipsos from the 1st to the 3rd, Ha Jeong-woo of the Democratic Party of Korea led with 38%, followed by Candidate Park at 26% and Candidate Han at 21%, within the margin of error. In a survey by Busan MBC and Han-gil Research during the same period, Ha received 34.3%, Han 33.5%, and Park 21.5% (refer to the website of the National Election Survey Deliberation Commission for details). <<> Both candidates will hold the opening ceremonies for their election offices on the 10th at 2 p.m. The two offices are located about a 10-minute walk apart. At Park’s opening ceremony, a large number of party leaders, including Representative Jang Dong-hyuk, are expected to attend. Chief Spokesperson Park Seong-hoon said that day, "There was a request from the candidate’s side, and the party leader is positively considering attending." <<> There is also interest in whether pro-Han lawmakers will attend the opening ceremony of Han’s election office. item.title: Iran Rejects Any Suspicion Regarding Namyang Fire: "Must Consult with Iran on Strait Passage" (이란, 나무호 화재에 “어떤 의혹도 거부…해협 통과 이란과 협의해야”)
item.description:
The Iranian Embassy in South Korea issued a statement on the 6th, declaring, "We strongly reject and clearly deny any suspicion that the Iranian military was involved in the incident regarding the damage suffered by a South Korean ship in the Strait of Hormuz." This asserts that Iran is not responsible for the fire that occurred on a vessel named Namyang, owned by the South Korean shipping company HMM, while it was in the Strait of Hormuz on the 4th. (주한국이란대사관은 6일 성명을 내어 “호르무즈해협에서 한국 선박이 입은 피해와 관련된 사건에 이란 군대가 개입했다는 어떤 의혹도 강력히 거부하며, 명확히 부인한다”고 밝혔다. 지난 4일 호르무즈해협에 있던 한국 선사 에이치엠엠(HMM) 소속 선박 나무호에서 발생한 화재가 이란의 책임이 아니라는 주장이다.)

In the statement, the Iranian Embassy said, "To safely transit the Strait of Hormuz, it is necessary to fully comply with relevant regulations, heed published warnings, follow designated routes, and cooperate with Iranian authorities." It added, "Ignoring these requirements and operational environments can lead to unintended incidents amid military and security tensions. The responsibility for such consequences rests with parties that attempt to pass through or operate in this area without fully considering these factors." The embassy further emphasized, "Iran has consistently stressed its commitment to ensuring maritime navigation safety and security in the region in compliance with international law and regulations, and will continue to do so." ( 이란대사관은 성명에서 “호르무즈해협을 안전하게 통과하기 위해서는 관련 규정을 완전히 준수하고 발표된 경고에 주의를 기울이며, 지정된 항로를 따르고 이란 관계 당국과 협력해야 한다”고 말했다. 이어 “이런 요구사항과 작전 환경을 무시할 경우, 군사 및 안보 긴장 속에서 의도치 않은 사건을 야기할 수 있다”며 “이런 결과에 대한 책임은 해당 요소를 충분히 고려하지 않고 이 지역을 통과하거나 활동하려는 당사자들에게 있다”고 했다. 그러면서 “이란은 국제법과 규정을 준수해 해당 지역의 해상 항해 안전과 안보를 보장하겠다는 의지를 지속적으로 강조했으고, 앞으로도 그럴 것”이라고 덧붙였다. )

The statement from the Iranian Embassy, released two days after the fire, is seen as a backlash against U.S. President Donald Trump's accusation that Iran was the cause of the fire. President Trump claimed on social media after the incident, "Iran attacked unrelated countries, including South Korean cargo ships." ( 화재 발생 이틀 뒤 나온 이란대사관의 성명은 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령이 이번 화재의 원인으로 이란을 지목한 데 대한 반발로 풀이된다. 트럼프 대통령은 화재 발생 뒤 소셜미디어를 통해 “이란이 한국 화물선을 포함해 관련 없는 국가들을 공격했다”고 주장했다. )

Meanwhile, National Security Office Director Seo Wook-jin maintained a cautious stance on the 6th, stating that "it does not seem confirmed that there was a strike," and said the government would conduct a thorough investigation into the exact cause. The vessel is currently being towed and is expected to arrive at port on the morning of the 7th, Seoul time. ( 이런 가운데 위성락 국가안보실장은 6일 아직은 “피격이 확실하지 않은 것 같다”며 신중론을 유지하면서 정확한 원인 조사를 하겠다고 밝혔다. 현재 해당 선박은 예인 중으로, 한국시각 7일 오전 항구로 들어올 전망이다.)

By Jang Ye-ji, staff reporter penj@hani.co.kr ( 장예지 기자 penj@hani.co.kr)
